_comment: Measures AGENTS.md (and writes through the CLAUDE.md symlink) against this repo's word limits on every edit. The limit was prose here and in four sibling repos and enforced in none; runbox-mcp's reached 2,621 words against an 1,850 ceiling before this existed. The hook only reports — PostToolUse runs after the write, so it cannot block one. Thresholds are passed as flags because the repos do not agree on them. See .claude/hooks/agents-md-length.mjs.
